recognize_zh: CD4 染色下，瀰漫浸潤的淋巴瘤細胞大多為陰性，只有零星散佈的組織球與背景 T 細胞呈棕色陽性，表示腫瘤細胞失去 CD4 表現。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the mucosa with residual glands at the left edge
The vast majority of infiltrating cells are CD4 negative
Scattered positive cells with dendritic or histiocytic shapes and occasional small positive lymphocytes serve as internal control
Glandular epithelium negative; faint background staining only
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on the mucosal biopsy shows that the diffuse infiltrate of lymphoid cells is predominantly negative. Scattered positive histiocytes and occasional background T cells provide an internal positive control. Together with negativity for CD20, CD5, CD7 and CD8, and positivity for CD3, CD56 and EBER, the immunoprofile is consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS is usually CD4 positive with retained or partially lost pan-T antigens and is EBER negative in tumor cells.
BPDCN is CD4+, CD56+ and CD123+ with blastic morphology and is CD3 and EBER negative.
Reactive infiltrates contain abundant CD4-positive helper T cells rather than a CD4-negative sheet.
